simple.meaning: אֶשְׁפָּר (ʼeshpâr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a measured portion.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Samuel 6:19. The surrounding context includes Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶשְׁפָּר (H829) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אֶשְׁפָּר (ʼeshpâr) / H829 is traced through 2 Samuel 6:19, 1 Chronicles 16:3 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.

timeline.evidenceText: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.
He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
